Part 2&3 物品 OBJECTS

Describe a movie you watched and enjoyed recently

描述一部你最近看并喜欢的电影

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a movie you watched and enjoyed recently

  • When and where you watched it (你什么时候在哪里看的)
  • Who you watched it with (你和谁一起看的)
  • What it was about (它讲的是什么)
  • And explain why you watched this movie (并解释你为什么看这部电影)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a movie you watched and enjoyed recently

I'd like to describe a movie I watched recently, Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse. I saw it about a month ago at a cinema in Buji, which is a district in Shenzhen where I live. It was a weekend afternoon, and the cinema was quite crowded, which surprised me a little. I watched it with my girlfriend. We usually go to the cinema together once or twice a month, and this time she was the one who suggested it, because she'd heard great things about the animation style. The movie is about a teenage boy named Miles Morales, who discovers he can travel between different universes where other Spider-Man versions exist. What impressed me most was the visual style, every frame looked like a moving comic book, with bright colors and creative action scenes. The story also had a lot of heart, especially the relationship between Miles and his parents. As for why I watched it, apart from my girlfriend's recommendation, I'm a big fan of superhero movies, and I'd enjoyed the first Spider-Verse film a lot. I have to say, I wasn't disappointed. We both left the cinema talking about our favorite scenes, and I'd definitely watch it again.

一个月前和女朋友在深圳布吉的电影院看了《蜘蛛侠：纵横宇宙》，讲少年迈尔斯穿越多元宇宙的故事；动画风格惊艳，故事也有温度，女朋友推荐加上我本来就喜欢超级英雄电影。

Q2What kinds of movies do you think are successful in your country?

I think comedy and action movies tend to be the most successful in my country, because they appeal to a wide audience and are easy to enjoy. In recent years, patriotic blockbusters have also done extremely well, especially during national holidays. That said, I believe success isn't only about box office numbers, some art films win awards and gain respect even with small audiences. So I'd say commercial success and artistic success are two different things, and both exist in our film industry.

喜剧和动作片最卖座，近年主旋律大片在假期也很火；但成功不只是票房，艺术片获奖也受尊重。

Q3What are the factors that make a successful movie?

I think there are several key factors. Firstly, a strong story is essential, because no matter how good the visuals are, a weak plot will disappoint the audience. Secondly, good acting and directing bring the story to life, and famous actors can attract initial attention. Also, timing matters, for example, a movie released during a holiday often performs better. I'd say the most important factor is emotional connection, because if the audience relates to the characters, they'll recommend it to others.

好故事是根本，演技和导演加分，档期也重要；最关键是与观众产生情感共鸣，口碑带动长期成功。

Q4Do Chinese people prefer to watch domestic movies or foreign movies?

I think it's mixed, but domestic movies have become increasingly popular in recent years. One reason is that local films often reflect Chinese culture and daily life, which makes them easier to relate to. Also, the quality of domestic productions has improved a lot, with better special effects and storytelling. That said, foreign movies, especially Hollywood blockbusters, still have a loyal audience, particularly among young people who enjoy their visual effects. So I'd say both have their place, and the choice often depends on the genre.

国产片近年越来越受欢迎（贴近生活、质量提升），但好莱坞大片在年轻人中仍有市场；看类型而定。

Q5Do you think only well-known directors can create the best movies?

No, I don't think so at all. While famous directors have more resources and experience, many great movies have been made by newcomers with fresh ideas. For example, some low-budget films directed by first-time directors have become huge hits because of their originality. I think creativity matters more than reputation, and the industry needs new voices to keep evolving. Having said that, well-known directors do have advantages, like easier access to funding and distribution, but that doesn't mean they always produce better work.

不一定，新导演常有新鲜创意，低成本黑马不少；创造力比名气重要，但名导在资金和发行上有优势。

Q6Do you think successful movies should have well-known actors or actresses in leading roles?

I'd say it helps, but it's not a guarantee of success. Well-known actors can attract audiences at the beginning, because people are curious about their favorite stars. However, if the movie itself is weak, even famous actors can't save it, and audiences will quickly lose interest. On the other hand, some movies with unknown actors have become massive successes purely because of their stories. So I think the script and direction matter more, while star power is just an extra advantage.

有名演员能吸引初期关注，但电影本身弱的话救不回来；也有无名演员靠故事大获成功的例子；剧本和导演更重要。

Q7Why do people prefer to watch movies in the cinema?

I think the main reason is the immersive experience. The big screen, surround sound and dark environment make people feel like they're inside the story, which a home TV can't fully provide. Also, going to the cinema is a social activity, since people often go with friends or family and share the experience. That said, with streaming services becoming so convenient, some people now prefer watching at home. So I'd say the cinema still wins for big blockbusters, but not for every movie.

沉浸感（大屏、环绕声、黑暗环境）是主因，也是社交活动；但流媒体方便，大片去影院、普通片在家看。
